从 Auckland Downtown Ferry Terminal 搭船约25: Take a boat from Auckland Downtown Ferry Terminal for about 25–40 minutes to arrive at Rangitoto Wharf, then hike along the Summit Track for about 1–1.5 hours.
从 Centennial Drive 附近停车区出发，沿陡峭阶梯及链条辅助路段攀: Depart from the parking area near Centennial Drive, and climb for about 20–30 minutes along steep stairs and chain-assisted sections.
从 Cooks Beach 经 Shakespeare Cliff Road 前: Head from Cooks Beach via Shakespeare Cliff Road toward the viewing area, park, and walk along the short trail to the heights of the cliff.
从 Dawson Falls 停车区沿 Wilkies Pools Loop T: Hike for about 20–30 minutes from the Dawson Falls parking area along the Wilkies Pools Loop Track to reach the creek pools; the complete loop takes about 1 hour.
从 Emerald Lakes 穿过 Central Crater，沿标记步道爬: Walk from Emerald Lakes across the Central Crater, and climb along the marked trail for about 30–45 minutes to reach the vicinity of the Blue Lake.
从 Hahei 沿 Hahei Beach Road 和 Hot Water B: Drive for about 15 minutes from Hahei along Hahei Beach Road and Hot Water Beach Road, and walk to the beach geothermal spring area.
从 Mangatepōpō 步道入口沿主步道约1–1.5小时到达瀑布岔路，再走短: Walk along the main trail from the Mangatepōpō trail head for about 1–1.5 hours to reach the waterfall junction, then take the short branch trail.
从 Mangorei Road 徒步上山，入住提前预约的 Pouākai Hut: Hike up the mountain from Mangorei Road, stay at the pre-booked Pouākai Hut, and photograph the mirror lake sunset in low wind.
从 Mangorei Road 沿连续木阶和森林步道上行约2–3小时抵达山屋。: Ascend along continuous wooden stairs and forest trails from Mangorei Road for about 2–3 hours to reach the hut.
从 Matamata 沿 SH29 与 Buckland Road 驾车约20分: Drive from Matamata along SH29 and Buckland Road for about 20 minutes to The Shire's Rest, and join the pre-booked official Hobbiton guided tour vehicle.
从 National Park Village 沿 SH47 转入 Mangat: Drive from National Park Village along SH47 onto Mangatepopo Road, taking about 20 minutes; booking a mountain-crossing shuttle to the trailhead is recommended.
从 New Plymouth 市区沿 Coastal Walkway 骑行约20: Cycle from downtown New Plymouth along the Coastal Walkway for about 20–30 minutes, or drive to the parking spot near the Waiwhakaiho River and walk.
从 New Plymouth 沿 Breakwater Road 驾车约15分钟: Drive from New Plymouth along Breakwater Road for about 15 minutes to reach the coastal parking area, then walk down to the beach via open stairs.
从 New Plymouth 沿 Mangorei Road 到步道停车场，沿: Drive from New Plymouth along Mangorei Road to the trail parking lot, ascend along the Mangorei Track for about 2–3 hours to Pouākai Hut, and walk another 20–30 minutes to reach the mirror lake.
从 New Plymouth 经 SH3 转 Egmont Road，约30–4: Turn from SH3 onto Egmont Road from New Plymouth, arriving at the North Taranaki Visitor Centre in about 30–40 minutes, and walk a few minutes into the nearby viewpoint.
从 Red Crater 沿松散火山碎石陡坡下降约20–40分钟，抵达翡翠湖步道: Descend from Red Crater along the loose volcanic scree steep slope for about 20–40 minutes, reaching the Emerald Lakes trail junction.
从 SH25 转 Hot Water Beach Road、Link Road: Turn from SH25 onto Hot Water Beach Road and Link Road toward Hahei, walk along the Cathedral Cove Track for about 45–90 minutes one-way according to current DOC open entry points, or arrive by boat under safe sea conditions.
从 Soda Springs 经 Devil's Staircase 陡坡持续爬: Climb continuously for about 1 hour from Soda Springs via the steep Devil's Staircase slope, entering the flat terrain of the South Crater.
从 South Crater 沿裸露山脊攀升约45–60分钟，抵达越岭路线最高点: Climb along the exposed ridge from South Crater for about 45–60 minutes to reach the highest point of the mountain-crossing route.
从 Stratford 经 SH3、Kaponga 方向转 Manaia Roa: Head from Stratford via SH3 and the Kaponga direction onto Manaia Road, arriving at the Dawson Falls road end in about 30 minutes, and follow the short trail to the waterfall viewing area.
从 Waitomo Glowworm Caves Visitor Centre: Complete guided tour formalities at the Waitomo Glowworm Caves Visitor Centre, proceed to the designated parking area of the Ruakuri Scenic Reserve, and take a short walk into the cave.
从 Waitomo Village 沿 Tumutumu Road 前往 Rua: Drive from Waitomo Village along Tumutumu Road toward the Ruakuri Cave visitor reception area for about 5–10 minutes; black water rafting requires assembling at a separate location designated by the operator.
从 Whakapapa Village 出发走 Taranaki Falls L: Depart from Whakapapa Village and take the Taranaki Falls Loop Track; the loop is about 6 km and takes around 2 hours.
从Balclutha离开SH1，经Owaka Highway、Kaka Poin: Leave SH1 from Balclutha, pass through Owaka Highway, Kaka Point Road, and The Nuggets Road to reach the parking area, and walk for about 10–20 minutes toward the lighthouse.
从Belfast Terrace步道入口进入Queenstown Hill Ti: Enter the Queenstown Hill Time Walk from the Belfast Terrace trail entrance, ascend in spirals through the coniferous forest, taking about 2–3 hours round trip.
从Buckingham Street西端步行约5–10分钟，沿Bush Cree: Walk from the western end of Buckingham Street for about 5–10 minutes, enter the DOC-maintained historic site along Bush Creek, and allow 30–45 minutes.
从Chaslands Highway转入Rewcastle Road，沿碎石道路: Turn from Chaslands Highway into Rewcastle Road, drive along the gravel road for about 3 km to the parking area, and walk along the McLean Falls Walk for about 20–30 minutes.
从Chinese Settlement附近Bush Creek步桥进入Arrow: Enter the Arrow Gorge Track from the Bush Creek pedestrian bridge near the Chinese Settlement, walk about 1.5 km upstream along the Arrow River to Norman Smith Bridge, taking about 1 hour round trip.
从Control Gates出发，经Brod Bay沿山毛榉森林持续爬升，完成约: Depart from Control Gates, continuously ascend through beech forest via Brod Bay, complete a hike of about 13.8 km to reach Luxmore Hut, and stay overnight at the hut.
从Control Gates沿Kepler Track经Brod Bay上升，单: Ascend from Control Gates along the Kepler Track via Brod Bay, about 13.8 km one-way, taking about 8 to 10 hours round trip during the day. Multi-day hikers can book accommodation at Luxmore Hut.
从Ford Street底部Tobins Track入口越过箭河，沿旧道路爬升约: Cross the Arrow River from the Tobins Track entrance at the bottom of Ford Street, ascend along the old road for about 30–45 minutes to the high viewpoint area, taking about 1–1.5 hours round trip.
从Forest Burn Shelter沿高山步道继续约3.8公里，经过开阔山脊: Continue for about 3.8 km along the alpine trail from Forest Burn Shelter, pass through open ridges and multiple climbs to reach the vicinity of Hanging Valley Shelter.
从Gillespies Beach停车区域沿DOC标识的海岸步道向北，经过湿地与: Head north from the Gillespies Beach parking area along the DOC-signed coastal trail, pass through wetlands and historic gold-mining ruins, and allow about 1.5–2 hours round trip for the lagoon viewing area.
从Glacier Access Road停车场沿Douglas Walk或Pet: Enter the rainforest from the Glacier Access Road parking lot following Douglas Walk or Peters Pool signs, take a short 20–30 minute round trip, while the complete Douglas Walk takes longer.
从Iris Burn Hut沿Kepler Track行走约16.2公里抵达；也: Walk about 16.2 km from Iris Burn Hut along the Kepler Track to arrive; you can also cross the Waiau River suspension bridge from the Rainbow Reach parking lot and hike about 6 km one-way to the lakeside.
从Jetty Viewpoint继续沿马瑟森湖环线步行约15分钟，根据路牌登上较: Continue past the Jetty Viewpoint along the Lake Matheson loop walk for about 15 minutes, and ascend to the higher View of Views vantage point according to the signposts.
Walk about 5.6 km from the Kepler Track Control Gates parking lot along the lakeside trail, taking about 1.5 hours one-way; you can also book a Lake Te Anau water taxi directly to a nearby landing point.
从Luxmore Hut沿开普勒主线穿越高山段，约14.6公里、5至6小时抵达I: Traverse the alpine section from Luxmore Hut along the Kepler main line, taking about 14.6 km and 5 to 6 hours to reach Iris Burn Hut; make an additional 40-minute round trip from the hut to the nearby waterfall branch trail.
从Milford Sound Visitor Terminal搭乘峡湾巡游船，完: Board a fjord cruise from the Milford Sound Visitor Terminal, with a complete cruise lasting about 1 hour 40 minutes to 2 hours. The captain decides the distance of approach to the waterfalls based on sea conditions.
从Moturau Hut徒步至Rainbow Reach，可搭预约接驳返回蒂阿瑙: Hike from Moturau Hut to Rainbow Reach, take a pre-booked shuttle back to Te Anau, or continue along the Waiau River to complete the full Kepler Track circuit.
从Mount Cook Village Public Shelter出发，跨越B: Depart from the Mount Cook Village Public Shelter, cross Black Birch Stream, and continuously ascend along the Red Tarns Track, taking about 2 hours round trip.
从Mull Street湖滨步道入口沿DOC指示进入Glenorchy Lago: Enter the Glenorchy Lagoon Walkway from the Mull Street lakeside trail entrance following DOC instructions; the full route from the pier is about 5.5 km round trip, allowing 1.5–2 hours.
从Octagon沿Stuart Street向东步行约8分钟抵达Anzac Sq: Walk east from the Octagon along Stuart Street for about 8 minutes to arrive at Anzac Square and the station facade.
从Owaka沿Southern Scenic Route向南，停靠Matai F: Head south from Owaka along the Southern Scenic Route, stop at the Matai Falls signposted parking area, walk for about 10–15 minutes, and visit Horseshoe Falls nearby following signs.
从SH1转入Moeraki Road及Lighthouse Road，沿约4公里: Turn from SH1 onto Moeraki Road and Lighthouse Road, arrive at the lighthouse parking area along the final 4-km road, and follow the open trail into the reserve.
从SH6进入Chard Farm Road，沿狭窄碎石支路驶至开放酒庄接待区，从: Turn from SH6 onto Chard Farm Road, drive along the narrow gravel branch road to the open winery reception area, about 10–15 minutes from the Kawarau Bungee Centre.
从SH8跨Tekapo River的公路桥附近进入Cowans Hill Wal: Enter the Cowans Hill Walkway near the highway bridge across the Tekapo River from SH8, and walk along river terraces, planted forests, and grassy slopes for about 1–1.5 hours.
从SH94旁The Divide停车场进入Routeburn Track，约1小: Enter the Routeburn Track from The Divide parking lot next to SH94, turn into the Key Summit branch trail after about 1 hour, taking about 3 hours round trip in total.
从Steamer Wharf沿湖滨步行约5–10分钟抵达Queenstown B: Walk from Steamer Wharf along the lakeside for about 5–10 minutes to reach Queenstown Bay Beach and the Marine Parade public waterfront area.
从Tasman Glacier停车场沿Blue Lakes方向步行，在冰川观景路: Walk from the Tasman Glacier parking lot toward Blue Lakes, enter the Blue Lake branch trail at the glacier viewing route fork, taking about 30–45 minutes round trip.
从Tekapo东侧沿SH8转入Lilybank Road，再循Roundhill: Turn from SH8 on the east side of Tekapo onto Lilybank Road, follow Roundhill Ski Area signs onto the alpine road, taking about 45–60 minutes by car.
从Tekapo沿Godley Peaks Road继续北行，依Lake McGr: Continue north from Tekapo along Godley Peaks Road, enter the legally open area following Lake McGregor and local campsite signs, taking about 25 minutes by car.
从Tekapo沿SH8转Godley Peaks Road，自驾约15分钟抵达P: Drive from Tekapo along SH8 onto Godley Peaks Road, arrive at the Peninsula Walkway parking area in about 15 minutes by car, and complete the lakeside loop in about 1.5–2 hours.
从Tekapo镇中心沿湖滨步道跨越人行桥，步行约10分钟抵达Pioneer Dr: Walk from the Tekapo town center along the lakeside trail across the pedestrian bridge, taking about 10 minutes to reach the Church on Pioneer Drive.
从Twizel沿SH8北行，在Pukaki Canal北侧转入Lake Poak: Drive north from Twizel along SH8, turn onto Lake Poaka Access Road north of the Pukaki Canal, and enter following DOC campsite instructions.
从Twizel沿SH8北行，转入SH80 Mount Cook Road，自驾约: Drive north from Twizel along SH8, turn onto SH80 Mount Cook Road, and drive for about 20–25 minutes to enter the official Peter's Lookout parking area.
从Twizel沿SH8向Omarama方向南行约5分钟，抵达2602 Twize: Drive south from Twizel along SH8 toward Omarama for about 5 minutes, arriving at the 2602 Twizel-Omarama Highway salmon farm.

从Twizel镇沿Max Smith Drive自驾约5–10分钟，前往Lake: Drive from Twizel town along Max Smith Drive for about 5–10 minutes to the Lake Ruataniwha Holiday Park and adjacent open waterfront.
从White Horse Hill停车场沿Kea Point Track步行约3: Walk about 30 minutes from the White Horse Hill parking lot along the Kea Point Track, or walk about 1 hour from the Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park Visitor Centre.
从White Horse Hill停车场沿胡克谷步道行走约15–20分钟，在第一: Walk about 15–20 minutes from the White Horse Hill parking lot along the Hooker Valley Track, arriving at the formal viewpoint before the first suspension bridge.

从卡瓦劳悬索桥沿SH6向东约数分钟进入Gibbston Valley Winer: Drive east from the Kawarau Suspension Bridge along SH6 for a few minutes to enter Gibbston Valley Winery; you can also cycle the open routes of the wine valley via the Gibbston River Trail.
从基督城经Sumner至Taylors Mistake停车场，车程40–50分钟: Drive from Christchurch via Sumner to the Taylors Mistake parking lot, taking 40–50 minutes; complete an approximately 3-hour headland hike along the Godley Head Loop Track.
从奥克兰经 SH1、SH2 和 SH25 进入半岛，根据潮汐安排 New Chu: Enter the peninsula from Auckland via SH1, SH2, and SH25, schedule New Chums Beach according to the tides, and stay in Whitianga or Hahei.

从库克山村沿Tasman Valley Road自驾约15分钟到停车场，沿Tas: Drive from Mount Cook Village along Tasman Valley Road for about 15 minutes to the parking lot, climb about 300 steps along the Tasman Glacier View Track, taking 40–60 minutes round trip.
从弗朗茨约瑟夫镇沿SH6向南过Waiho River Bridge，转入Glac: Drive south from Franz Josef town along SH6 past the Waiho River Bridge, turn onto Glacier Access Road, arrive at the glacier valley parking lot, and take a 20-minute round trip along the Sentinel Rock Walk.

从格林诺奇沿Glenorchy–Paradise Road北行约30分钟至Dia: Drive north from Glenorchy along the Glenorchy–Paradise Road for about 30 minutes to the vicinity of the Diamond Lake Campsite, and use open areas where parking and walking are permitted.
从格林诺奇经Dart River Bridge及Kinloch Road绕行至湖: Bypass via Dart River Bridge and Kinloch Road from Glenorchy to the west shore of the lake, a road distance of about 27 km, taking about 40–50 minutes by car.
从桥的适当一端调整轴线对准火山，不占用骑行通道；该点以雪山景观为收录目的，不作为: Adjust the axis from the appropriate end of the bridge to align with the volcano without occupying the cycling lane; this point is intended for recording snow mountain landscapes rather than master architectural archives.

从瓦纳卡湖滨码头乘预约水上出租船或生态导览船，航行约35–45分钟登岛，再沿Ar: Take a pre-booked water taxi or eco-cruise boat from the Wanaka lakeside pier to the island in about 35–45 minutes, then walk along the Arethusa Pool Track for about 45 minutes to the high viewpoint area.
从瓦纳卡镇中心沿湖滨步道向西南步行约15–20分钟，或沿Wanaka–Mount: Walk southwest from the Wanaka town center along the lakeside trail for about 15–20 minutes, or drive along the Wanaka–Mount Aspiring Road to a nearby legal parking spot, then walk to the lakeshore.
从皇后镇Steamer Wharf乘RealNZ蒸汽船约45分钟至Walter: Take the RealNZ steamship from Queenstown Steamer Wharf for about 45 minutes to Walter Peak High Country Farm, and participate in farm or dining landing experiences.

从皇后镇沿Glenorchy–Queenstown Road向西约6公里，转入M: Drive west from Queenstown along the Glenorchy–Queenstown Road for about 6 km, turn onto Moke Lake Road, and drive another 7 km on gravel road to the DOC campsite, taking about 30 minutes in total.
从皇后镇沿Glenorchy–Queenstown Road行驶约25公里至Be: Drive from Queenstown along the Glenorchy–Queenstown Road for about 25 km to the Bennetts Bluff dedicated parking lot, and walk along the signed trail for about 15 minutes round trip.
从皇后镇沿Gorge Road及Arthurs Point Road北行约10–: Drive north from Queenstown along Gorge Road and Arthurs Point Road for about 10–15 minutes to the legal parking area near the Edith Cavell Bridge; jet boats depart from the Shotover Jet base.
从皇后镇经SH6和Arrowtown–Lake Hayes Road自驾约20–: Drive from Queenstown via SH6 and Arrowtown–Lake Hayes Road for about 20–30 minutes, or take the Queenstown Orbus to the stop near Ramshaw Lane in Arrowtown, then walk for about 5 minutes.
从神奇峡湾主航道驶向塔斯曼海入口，海况允许时由运营商巡游经过外海岛礁附近。: Sail from the main Fiordland navigation channel toward the entrance of the Tasman Sea, and cruise past nearby offshore islands with the operator when sea conditions permit.
从福克斯镇沿Cook Flat Road和Gillespies Beach Ro: Drive west from Fox Glacier along Cook Flat Road and Gillespies Beach Road for about 21 km, with the latter section containing gravel roads, allowing 35–45 minutes to reach the coastal parking campsite, then enter the beach along the public trail.
从福克斯镇沿Cook Flat Road转Lake Matheson Road，: Drive from Fox Glacier along Cook Flat Road onto Lake Matheson Road, taking about 10 minutes by car to the scenic area parking lot, and walk along the forest trail for about 20 minutes to reach the lake floating viewing platform.
从福克斯镇沿SH6南行约2公里，过Fox River Bridge后进入左侧停车: Drive south from Fox Glacier along SH6 for about 2 km, cross the Fox River Bridge and enter the left parking area, walk through the primeval forest along the South Side Walkway, with a complete round trip of about 6.4 km taking 2 hours.
从箭镇沿Arrowtown–Lake Hayes Road南行约10分钟，经SH: Drive south from Arrowtown along Arrowtown–Lake Hayes Road for about 10 minutes, pass through SH6 to the Lake Hayes Pavilion parking area, and walk to connect to the lake-loop trail.
从罗托鲁瓦市中心沿 Fenton Street 南行约10分钟，进入 Te Pu: Drive south from downtown Rotorua along Fenton Street for about 10 minutes, enter the Te Puia geothermal scenic area, and join the prescribed guided tour.
从罗托鲁瓦市中心驾车约10分钟至 Tītokorangi Drive 入口，购买: Drive from downtown Rotorua for about 10 minutes to the Tītokorangi Drive entrance, and purchase tickets for the corresponding time slot of the Treewalk or Nightlights.
从罗托鲁瓦沿 SH5 向南约30分钟，转 Waiotapu Loop Road: Drive south from Rotorua along SH5 for about 30 minutes, turn onto Waiotapu Loop Road into the scenic area, and walk along the marked trail within the park toward the Champagne Pool.
从罗托鲁瓦经 SH5 转 Waimangu Road，车程约25分钟；进入 Wa: Pass from Rotorua via SH5 onto Waimangu Road, taking about 25 minutes by car; enter the Waimangu Volcanic Valley and climb along the trail to the Inferno Crater viewpoint.
